entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I think I need to return it. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Maria Valenti, order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Maria. I have your order pulled up here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the problem? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it works fine! It's just... well, I guess I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy around the holidays, and honestly, I just don't use it. The policy online was so hard to follow. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria. I understand completely. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 41 days ago.
Right, so is that too long? I was getting worried I'd have to try some online resale marketplace or something, and I wouldn't even know where to start with that.

Let me check the official policy for you. One moment... (typing sounds) ... Okay, thank you for your patience. According to my system, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in the original condition. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's a huge relief! The new product page I saw must have been for something else. So I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac! You've made this so easy. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
